name: Horatio Dangerous
caption: The diary's first-person narrator, a retired wrestler who takes over TCW's booking from Joel Bryant after the "Just Another Day?" pay-per-view in March 2008, takes the third seat on the commentary desk, hosts the Spotlight Interviews and sets down the shows as a book for TCW's own books line. In September 2008 he writes of a best-ever pay-per-view buyrate for Hotter Than Hell, a second developmental federation in Puerto Rico and the SWF's change of booker. In October 2008 he interviews Jeremy Stone over three weeks on Total Wrestling. In November 2008 he finds himself tied in a length of silver chain in his hotel room by Eddie Peak's prank, learns from a phone call that Jennifer Cornell has arranged the signing of seventeen women through Angel Athletic Association, renames the jobber Dave Wallace as the American Eagle, renegotiates Badge of Honor for another two seasons and calls the shows on commentary. In December 2008 he learns that his daughter Kate has signed with TCW, agrees to a return to the ring after ten years in an intergender tag with her, is beaten up by Chris Rockwell on commentary and in the match, interviews Texas Pete over three Total Wrestling shows and sees his sons Richard and Adrian weigh offers from other promotions.

tenures.role: head booker (the narrator) and third commentator

name: Tommy Cornell
caption: TCW's English owner, its World Heavyweight Champion and the leader of the Syndicate, who holds almost all the gold with his stable, keeps Troy Tornado from a rematch until the Board's new representative makes it, and signs the diary's foreword as a book, and loses the World Heavyweight Championship to Troy Tornado at Excessive Force in June 2008, and beats Eddie Peak at Summer Showdown in July 2008 after a falling-out with Sam Keith, and in August 2008 signs Tyson Baine as the Syndicate's sixth man and, at Hotter Than Hell, is beaten by Sam Keith in a No Holds Barred match, leaving the ring holding his arm, and in September 2008 wins his Total Wrestling matches, promises that by July 2009 every championship in TCW will belong to the Syndicate and, at Destructive Energy, submits to Troy Tornado and Johnny Bloodstone in the three-way World Heavyweight Championship match, and in October 2008 walks off with the World Heavyweight Championship belt, is barred by the Board from title matches for six months, tests Aaron Andrews and Hell Monkey in the ring and, at Crunch Time, is beaten by Sam Keith in the Test of Steel. In November 2008 he beats Lobo Blanco and Chance Fortune in his tests, beats Sam Keith & the Machines with the Stone Brothers and the Balcony Express with Wolf Hawkins, loses with Tyson Baine to Rick Law and Troy Tornado, sends Marat Khoklov after Eddie Peak and at A Little South Of Sanity is beaten by Tornado in a non-title match despite Baine's help. In December 2008 he beats Rocky Golden in a brawl that echoes his match with Nemesis, beats Joey Minnesota as one of his tests, fights Troy Tornado to a no contest when Jack Bruce returns, falls out with Wolf Hawkins over Aaron Andrews and at Psycho Circus beats Andrews with Hawkins's chair before attacking Tornado and Eddie Peak with the retired TCW belt.

name: Joel Bryant
caption: TCW's head booker until the "Just Another Day?" pay-per-view, who stays on the creative team after handing the book over, and half of the Tag Team Specialists with Robert Oxford, a pair who cheat and finish with the One Shot Drop, until Oxford's knee injury leaves him teaming with Sean Deeley in July 2008, and in September 2008 beats Harry Allen with the One Shot Drop, Laura Huggins tripping Allen's ankle, and is submitted by Scout's Special Force at Destructive Energy. In November 2008 he loses to Rick Law on Badge of Honor, pins Dean Waldorf in the School of Tradition's win over the Balcony Express and sits on the booking committee as the women's division is debated. In December 2008 he is beaten by Sean Deeley and by Rocky Golden's Rocky Road.

name: Cliff Anderson
caption: The owner of Coastal Zone Combat Wrestling, TCW's developmental territory, who has long had bankruptcy worries until Tommy Cornell's money backs him.

name: Mayhem Midden
caption: A retired wrestler who walks out on the show in May 2008 as the Board's new representative, over Tommy Cornell's protest, to run matches the fans want, bar interference from the Syndicate and Painful Procedure at Total Mayhem 13 and make Ricky Dale Johnson its guest enforcer, and in August 2008 headbutts Wolf Hawkins, names Charlie Thatcher his enforcer, puts Edd Stone's challenger to a fans' web poll and sits at the announce desk for Hotter Than Hell, and in September 2008 waives a time limit, headbutts Edd Stone to stop a Syndicate brawl, makes the Rockwell and Ino and the Fonzarelli and Perez hair matches, will not sanction Rocky Golden's match with the contractless Marat Khoklov and takes the World Heavyweight Championship finish to the Board at Destructive Energy, and in October 2008 announces a tag team tournament, bars Tommy Cornell and Tyson Baine from title matches for six months, makes the ten-man battle royal for the third place in the Crunch Time main event and calls Crunch Time on commentary. In November 2008 he delivers the Board's edict that Troy Tornado's and Johnny Bloodstone's belts are recognised and will be unified at Malice in Wonderland in January, puts Sean Deeley or Freddy Huggins into the All Action Championship four-way and the Stone Brothers into the tag title match, warns Floyd Goldworthy about American Buffalo's fines and calls A Little South Of Sanity on commentary. In December 2008 he orders the Board's matches for the third place in Troy Tornado's defence, sends Chris Rockwell home, calls shows on commentary and announces at Psycho Circus that the Board will introduce a Women's Championship for 2009.

name: Jasmine Saunders
caption: A newcomer the narrator calls a future face of the promotion, a voice Tommy Cornell wants the fans to accept, who warms up the crowd before the March 2008 taping.

name: Jason Azaria
caption: TCW's play-by-play man, a commentator with an expense account for rare footage who sells every signing's pedigree and the names of every move.

name: Kyle Rhodes
caption: A colour commentator the narrator is less fond of than the rest of the desk, due to be phased off the television show and left in the second seat on pay-per-view.

name: Shawn Doakes
caption: A young announcer who wants to be TCW's play-by-play man, takes the second seat on Total Wrestling as a test and makes the ring announcements at Total Mayhem 13.

name: Floyd Goldworthy
caption: 'The Fast Buck', a long-standing heel manager, who speaks for American Buffalo while Buffalo plots revenge on Tyson Baine. In September 2008 he also manages the Fly Boys, and looks horrified when American Buffalo turns on Kingman & Alexander with them. In November 2008 he is held against a wall by Mayhem Midden, who tells him that American Buffalo's contract is subcontracted through his manager's licence, and is taunted by Phil Vibert. In December 2008 he whispers that his clients are not out of the championship picture, is confronted by American Buffalo over his title shot and manages the Fly Boys against the New Wave and the Keith Brothers.

name: Karen Killer
caption: Sammy Bach's manager, once the voice of Tyson Baine, taken out on the Where Angels Fear To Tread card by the narrator's own idea so that Bach can be seen on his own. At ringside with the Easy Riders through September 2008, she is reported on 27 September to have declined to extend her TCW contract, which the narrator puts down to job satisfaction rather than money. In October 2008 the Easy Riders tell her they have signed new contracts and, on her last night with the company, throw her over for Carl Batch and send her into the Emergency Stop, while the narrator and she part on good terms with talk of a return in a year or two.

name: Laura Huggins
caption: Freddy Huggins's twin sister and manager, a business graduate in sharp executive clothes who turns to Eric Tyler's cause. In September 2008 she calls the submission when Johnny Bloodstone beats Sean Deeley and, to punish her brother for hitting Eric Tyler with the Huggins Kiss, distracts the referee while Acid submits him. In October 2008 she distracts referees for Sean Deeley, Eric Tyler and Acid and sees her brother's Huggins Kiss land on Deeley by mistake on Badge of Honor. In November 2008 she is given the choice between Sean Deeley and her brother Freddy for the All Action Championship four-way, distracts referees for Acid and Sean Deeley, punches Freddy in the crotch on Badge of Honor and sees Eric Tyler pick Freddy. In December 2008 she throws in the towel for Sean Deeley against the New Wave, takes up with Deeley and is shoved to the ground by her brother Freddy.

name: Blonde Bombshell
caption: The valet who brings Johnny Bloodstone to the Where Angels Fear To Tread ring and goes with him on the shows that follow. In September 2008 she raises Troy Tornado's and Johnny Bloodstone's hands together at Destructive Energy after they make Tommy Cornell submit. In November 2008 she is back with Johnny Bloodstone, goes to ringside for Sam Keith, Matthew Keith and Greg Keith, and tells the Total Wrestling audience that she has two champions under contract and wants a third, saying she did not understand how good she had it in TCW the first time. In December 2008 she is at ringside for Johnny Bloodstone, Sam Keith, the Keith Brothers, Art Reed and Sean Deeley, and speaks at Psycho Circus for Johnny Bloodstone as the best of Sam Keith's trainees.

name: Baroness Emily
caption: A demoted manager who aligns with Koshiro Ino at Total Mayhem 13 in a black leather bodysuit with his facepaint across the chest. In September 2008 she tells Chris Rockwell to meet Ino at Destructive Energy, is punched by Rockwell and watches him beat Ino. In November 2008 she leads Koshiro Ino to ringside, talks quietly with Ino and Shingen Miyazaki and is at ringside for Ino and Team VIPER. In December 2008 she is at ringside for Hidekazu, Koshiro Ino and Team VIPER.

name: Eugene Williams
caption: One of TCW's three referees, the one who works the opening matches and the International title match at Where Angels Fear To Tread. In November 2008 he ejects Acid from ringside, lets Rick Law & Troy Tornado go two on one against Tommy Cornell & Tyson Baine and sends the Badge of Honor six-man match to a no contest. In December 2008 he rules the Tommy Cornell and Troy Tornado match a no contest after twenty-one minutes.

name: Ray Johnson
caption: One of TCW's referees, who counts American Buffalo's win over Tyson Baine at Where Angels Fear To Tread. In November 2008 he throws out the Keith Brothers' match with the New Wave and referees Troy Tornado's non-title match with Tommy Cornell at A Little South Of Sanity. In December 2008 he calls the no contest between Aaron Andrews and Sean Deeley and disqualifies Chris Rockwell.

name: Sam Sparrow
caption: TCW's top referee, who stops Ricky Dale Johnson's draw with Sammy Bach and calls the bell at Total Mayhem 13. In November 2008 he is knocked out in the Stone-Tornado match, becomes the target of Julian Watson's vendetta and referees the three-way International Championship match at A Little South Of Sanity. In December 2008 he calls for the bell on several disqualifications and referees the International Championship time-limit draw.

name: Sam Keith
caption: New to TCW at 47, a former Burning Hammer World Champion and the Syndicate's elder statesman, dubbed its 'Contract Killer', who runs interference for Tommy Cornell and finishes with the Neutron Plex or the Proton Lock, and wins the first Hard Hitting Championship at Excessive Force in June 2008, and is out of the Syndicate by the end of July 2008, when he keeps the title against Ricky Dale Johnson at Summer Showdown, and in August 2008 brings his twin sons into TCW, then beats Tommy Cornell in a No Holds Barred match at Hotter Than Hell to keep the title, and in September 2008 draws with Chris Rockwell on Total Wrestling to keep the Hard Hitting Championship and beats Jeremy Stone with the Proton Lock in a No Holds Barred match at Destructive Energy, and in October 2008 is beaten down by Tyson Baine, fights on with his twin sons at his side and, at Crunch Time, beats Tommy Cornell in the Test of Steel. In November 2008 he beats JD Morgan with the Proton Lock, is hit by Sammy Bach's chair, beats Sammy Bach with the NeutronPlex at A Little South Of Sanity to keep the Hard-Hitting Championship and, in tag matches, loses with the Machines to Tommy Cornell & the Stone Brothers, beats the Elite Express with Johnny Bloodstone and loses with Rick Law to Remo Richardson & Sammy Bach. In December 2008 he wins by disqualification over Frankie Perez and over Texas Pete, each time after Sammy Bach chairs him, teams with his sons against Sammy Bach and the Easy Riders and, at Psycho Circus, loses by disqualification to Sammy Bach in a No Holds Barred match but keeps the Hard-Hitting Championship.

name: Ricky Dale Johnson
caption: TCW's second-biggest paycheck, a brawler and long-time babyface who loses his last title shot against Tommy Cornell at Just Another Day?, is barred from challenging him and is named guest enforcer for the Cornell and Troy Tornado title match at Total Mayhem 13, and who becomes number one contender for the Hard Hitting Championship in July 2008 and loses to Sam Keith at Summer Showdown, and in August 2008 beats JD Morgan and American Buffalo and, with Danny Fonzarelli, Chris Rockwell and Frankie Perez at Hotter Than Hell. In September 2008 he beats Fumihiro Ota with the Leaping Lariat, loses with Johnny Bloodstone to Tommy Cornell and Wolf Hawkins and emails the narrator to ask what he is to do, which the diary says will be answered in 2009, and in October 2008 beats Frankie Perez, loses with Johnny Bloodstone to Jeremy Stone & Tommy Cornell, confronts Mayhem Midden about being overlooked and, at Crunch Time, beats Chris Rockwell and then pulls Remo Richardson out of the main event. In November 2008 he explains why he turned on Remo Richardson, draws with Eddie Peak against Marat Khoklov & Remo Richardson, is injured by Remo's chair, is given the women's division by the booking committee and at A Little South Of Sanity, fighting for TCW's honour, loses to Remo when Phil Vibert holds his boot. In December 2008 he beats the British Lions and Frankie Perez & Texas Pete with Danny Fonzarelli, is beaten by Jeremy Stone in the number one contendership match and by Tyson Baine, is beaten down by Baine and Remo Richardson and at Psycho Circus beats Richardson in a steel cage match.

name: Tyson Baine
caption: A Canadian monster formerly billed as BLZ Bubb, now an unlikely fan favourite who scares the bad guys, ambushed by American Buffalo and beaten by him at Where Angels Fear To Tread, then the winner of their Last Man Standing match at Total Mayhem 13, and in August 2008 is made official as the Syndicate's sixth man and beats Eddie Peak at Hotter Than Hell, and in September 2008 loses to Troy Tornado, draws in a tag with Jeremy Stone against Sam Keith and Eddie Peak and draws with Peak in a steel cage at Destructive Energy, and in October 2008 destroys Sam Keith, Hades Bombs Mayhem Midden and Troy Tornado, is barred from title matches for six months and, at Crunch Time, loses the Chain match to Eddie Peak. In November 2008 he beats Stevie Grayson with three Hades Bombs, loses with Tommy Cornell to Rick Law and Troy Tornado and beats the American Eagle, and at A Little South Of Sanity helps Cornell against Troy Tornado until Rick Law drives him away with a baton. In December 2008 he blindsides Rick Law, beats Ricky Dale Johnson with the Hades Bomb, is struck by Rick Law's nightstick, beats John Anderson and Rick Law with Wolf Hawkins and at Psycho Circus is beaten by Law in a No Disqualification match.

name: Wolf Hawkins
caption: Tommy Cornell's protege and International Champion, trained by Cornell and a member of the Syndicate, who keeps the belt against Koshiro Ino at Where Angels Fear To Tread with Sam Keith's help and loses it to him at Total Mayhem 13, then loses to Sam Keith on Total Wrestling in August 2008 and goes to Hotter Than Hell as a challenger for the World Heavyweight Championship, which he fails to win, and in September 2008 beats John Anderson by count out without winning the International Championship, is hit with a chair by Stevie Grayson, teams with Tommy Cornell on Total Wrestling and joins Sammy Bach to beat the Disrespected by disqualification at Destructive Energy, and in October 2008 loses with Tommy Cornell to Eddie Peak and Troy Tornado, wins the Hangtime match, is unsettled by Sam Keith's warning and, with Sammy Bach, beats the Disrespected at Crunch Time. In November 2008 he refuses to take his match for Sam Keith's title, saying he owes Sammy Bach a favour, catches Texas Pete from behind in John Anderson's title defence and announces that the International Championship is 'coming back home', beats the Keith Brothers and the Balcony Express with Tommy Cornell, loses to Rick Law and, at A Little South Of Sanity, is pinned by John Anderson in the three-way International Championship match. In December 2008 he beats Aaron Andrews with two Full Moon Risings after faking a knee injury, hits American Buffalo with a Full Moon Rising to help John Anderson keep the International Championship, draws with Anderson at the time limit, beats Anderson and Rick Law with Tyson Baine, quarrels with Tommy Cornell over Aaron Andrews and at Psycho Circus helps Cornell beat Andrews with a chair before losing to Anderson for the International Championship.

name: Rocky Golden
caption: A big, hard-hitting wrestler who tires easily, who loses to Sammy Bach in April and to Tommy Cornell in May, drifting aimlessly while the narrator works out what to do with him, and in September 2008 beats JD Morgan and Sammy Bach, demands a match with Marat Khoklov and is beaten senseless by him at Destructive Energy, leaving on a stretcher. In December 2008 he loses to Tommy Cornell, beats Chris Rockwell by disqualification, beats Rhino Umaga and Joel Bryant with the Rocky Road, offers to partner Kate Dangerous and, at Psycho Circus, loses with her to Rockwell and Lauren Easter when Rockwell makes him tap out.

name: Troy Tornado
caption: The frontman of Painful Procedure, who comes back from a shoulder injury as a fan favourite, challenges Tommy Cornell for the World Heavyweight Championship at Where Angels Fear To Tread and again at Total Mayhem 13, where Cornell is disqualified and keeps the belt, and wins the title from Cornell at Excessive Force in June 2008 with the Star Maker, and keeps it against Chris Rockwell and Wolf Hawkins at Summer Showdown in July 2008, and keeps it again at Hotter Than Hell in August 2008, beating Brent Hill and Wolf Hawkins in a three-way match, and in September 2008 beats Tyson Baine, Sammy Bach in a ladder match and Chris Rockwell and Eddie Peak, then at Destructive Energy makes Tommy Cornell submit with Johnny Bloodstone in a three-way match that leaves the result with the Board, and in October 2008 carries a new custom belt as the Standing Champion, beats Sammy Bach & Wolf Hawkins with Koshiro Ino and, at Crunch Time, beats Jeremy Stone and Remo Richardson in a three-way match with the Star Maker. In November 2008 he beats Jeremy Stone, beats Tommy Cornell & Tyson Baine with Rick Law, takes a six-man loss with John Anderson and Johnny Bloodstone and, at A Little South Of Sanity, beats Tommy Cornell in a non-title match with the Star Maker and cuts off Chris Rockwell when Rockwell and Remo Richardson brawl after Bloodstone's win. In December 2008 he beats the Stone Brothers with Rick Law and is attacked by Jeremy Stone, draws with Eric Tyler, beats Acid, Eric Tyler and Freddy Huggins with the Young Guns, fights Tommy Cornell to a no contest when Jack Bruce returns, picks Remo Richardson, Brent Hill and Rick Law for the six-man match for the third place in his defence and at Psycho Circus beats Eddie Peak and Jeremy Stone in a three-way match to keep the World Heavyweight Championship.

name: American Buffalo
caption: A hot-tempered brawler managed by Floyd Goldworthy, who Stampedes Tyson Baine through a barrier from the ramp to repay a betrayal the diary says came twelve years before, when Baine was BLZ Bubb and he was Morpheus. In September 2008 he loses to Koshiro Ino and, with Fumihiro Ota, to Kingman & Alexander, then shakes his head at Goldworthy and Stampedes the Kings with the Fly Boys. In November 2008 he blindsides Kingman & Alexander on Badge of Honor, loses to Koshiro Ino, loses with JD Morgan to the New Wave and is fined and warned by Mayhem Midden through Floyd Goldworthy. In December 2008 he demands his title shot from Floyd Goldworthy and loses to John Anderson after Wolf Hawkins's interference.

name: Koshiro Ino
caption: 'The Kobra', trained by Hooded Kudo and a former Burning Hammer tag champion, who chases Wolf Hawkins for the International Championship through interference in March, April and May, and wins it at Total Mayhem 13, then keeps it in July 2008 (Tommy Cornell beats him only by disqualification) and against Sammy Bach at Summer Showdown, then loses it to John Anderson at Hotter Than Hell in August 2008, then beats American Buffalo and Frankie Perez in September 2008 and, in the rematch he has chased for nearly three months, loses to Chris Rockwell at Destructive Energy, and in October 2008 beats Shingen Miyazaki and Fumihiro Ota, teams with Troy Tornado to beat Sammy Bach & Wolf Hawkins and is eliminated from the battle royal. In November 2008 he loses with Danny Fonzarelli to the Easy Riders, beats American Buffalo with the Kobra's Bite, loses to Eric Tyler with the Tradition Lift and, with Baroness Emily and Team VIPER, goes to a no contest against Acid, Eric Tyler & Freddy Huggins. In December 2008 he beats Freddy Huggins and JD Morgan with the Kobra's Bite and sees Team VIPER lose to Tommy Cornell & Wolf Hawkins and to the Easy Riders.

name: Sammy Bach
caption: The All Action Champion with a brooding rock idol gimmick, a former DaVE high flyer who is held to a draw by Ricky Dale Johnson, refuses the Syndicate and loses the belt to Edd Stone at Total Mayhem 13, and in September 2008 wins by disqualification against the New Wave with Freddy Huggins, loses to Rocky Golden and to Troy Tornado in a ladder match, then allies with Wolf Hawkins to beat the Disrespected by disqualification at Destructive Energy, and in October 2008 takes out Teddy Powell with a Motion Censor to help the Keith Brothers, loses to Koshiro Ino and Troy Tornado with Wolf Hawkins, is struck down by Stevie Grayson and Teddy Powell in the All Action contendership and, at Crunch Time, beats the Disrespected with Hawkins. In November 2008 he superkicks a chair into Sam Keith's face to claim his title match, plays a menacing guitar video, beats Rick Law & Sam Keith with Remo Richardson and at A Little South Of Sanity loses to Sam Keith's NeutronPlex. In December 2008 he beats Aaron Andrews with the Bach on your Back, chairs Sam Keith twice to end his matches, loses with the Easy Riders to the Keith Family and at Psycho Circus beats Sam Keith by disqualification when Texas Pete hits him with a chair, without winning the Hard-Hitting Championship.

name: Joey Minnesota
caption: A bearded former DaVE technician the narrator thinks could be one of TCW's best, who sides with Aaron Andrews against Eric Tyler's demands for respect, and in August 2008 wins twice with Aaron Andrews over Miyazaki & Ota, loses to Sammy Bach and goes to a no contest with Eric Tyler when Rick Law interferes, and in September 2008 beats the British Lions twice with Aaron Andrews as the Rising Stars, loses to the School of Tradition and to Chris Rockwell, and in October 2008 beats the School of Tradition with Aaron Andrews as the Rising Stars, loses to the Easy Riders and is eliminated from the battle royal. In November 2008 he loses to Texas Pete's Lone Star Drop, beats Freddy Huggins & Sean Deeley with Art Reed and is beaten by Marat Khoklov's Moscow Lariat. In December 2008 he beats Sean Deeley with the Empire Spiral, and is beaten by Tommy Cornell as one of Cornell's tests.

name: Eric Tyler
caption: A Canadian veteran and sympathetic heel who preaches respect for tradition, goes after Aaron Andrews, allies with Freddy Huggins and wins the Respect Is Earned Invitational at Total Mayhem 13, and in August 2008 has Rick Law's show set against him, loses a hardcore match to Eddie Peak and, at Hotter Than Hell, loses to Law, and in September 2008 hits Rick Law with a chair, brings in Marat Khoklov, loses two tag matches and loses the International Championship match to John Anderson at Destructive Energy, and in October 2008 beats Art Reed and Aaron Andrews, is eliminated from the battle royal and, at Crunch Time, draws with Rick Law in a Last Man Standing match. In November 2008 he loses by disqualification to Eddie Peak, beats Koshiro Ino with the Tradition Lift and chooses Freddy Huggins over Sean Deeley for the All Action Championship four-way. In December 2008 he beats Hidekazu with the Tradition Lift, draws with Troy Tornado after twenty minutes, loses with Acid and Freddy Huggins to Troy Tornado and the Young Guns asks for Sean Deeley to be matched against his own partner Joel Bryant and sees Deeley leave the School of Tradition.

name: Danny Fonzarelli
caption: 'Dr Love', Ricky Dale Johnson's ally, hounded by the Tag Team Specialists, whose own finisher is the Retro Rocket and who borrows Joel Bryant's One Shot Drop and Robert Oxford's top-rope knee drop, and in September 2008 confronts Frankie Perez over his hair-pulling, helps John Anderson by holding Perez's hair and loses their hair against hair match at Destructive Energy, ending shaved bald, and in October 2008 sheds the Dr Love image, loses to Edd Stone and to Remo Richardson and, with Ricky Dale Johnson, wins by disqualification over the Easy Riders. In November 2008 he loses with Koshiro Ino to the Easy Riders and is beaten by Chris Rockwell's Furusawa Armbar. In December 2008 he wins with Ricky Dale Johnson over the British Lions and Frankie Perez & Texas Pete, and is clotheslined by Remo Richardson.

name: Eddie Peak
caption: 'The Great White Shark', a former DaVE man and fan favourite who works as an ultraviolent brawler, who feuds with Wolf Hawkins and Tommy Cornell and plays rib jokes on the narrator, and in August 2008 beats Eric Tyler in a hardcore match on Badge of Honor, then loses to Tyson Baine at Hotter Than Hell, and in September 2008 draws with Tyson Baine in a steel cage at Destructive Energy after teaming with Sam Keith to draw with Jeremy Stone and Baine, and in October 2008 is attacked by Tyson Baine, splits Baine's scalp with a chain-wrapped fist, is eliminated from the battle royal and, at Crunch Time, beats Baine in the Chain match. In November 2008 he beats Eric Tyler by disqualification when Marat Khoklov attacks, draws with Ricky Dale Johnson against Khoklov & Remo Richardson, beats Merle O'Curle and flees a backstage brawl with Khoklov, then loses to Khoklov's Moscow Lariat in a No Disqualification match at A Little South Of Sanity. In December 2008 he beats Rhino Umaga, pins Chris Rockwell to win the six-man match and a place in the Triple-Threat defence, and at Psycho Circus is laid out by Tommy Cornell's Rough Ride and a belt shot as Troy Tornado keeps the title.

name: Rick Law
caption: A flag-waving wrestling cop who 'respects the badge' and finishes with the Long Arm of the Law, who is said to have taken the new Friday show, Badge of Honor, as his own, is beaten up by the School of Tradition in August 2008, books their matches from his living room by satellite link and beats Eric Tyler at Hotter Than Hell with the Long Arm of the Law, and in September 2008 loses a tag match with Rocky Golden to the Easy Riders, beats Peter Hopper with a sunset flip, is flattened by Marat Khoklov and, at Destructive Energy, leads the Russian out of the arena to save Rocky Golden, and in October 2008 beats Sean Deeley, beats American Buffalo by disqualification and, at Crunch Time, draws with Eric Tyler in a Last Man Standing match. In November 2008 he loses to Remo Richardson and beats Frankie Perez, Joel Bryant, Wolf Hawkins and Texas Pete, teams with Troy Tornado to beat Tommy Cornell & Tyson Baine and, at A Little South Of Sanity, arrives at ringside with a security baton to beat down Tyson Baine for Tornado. In December 2008 he beats Jeremy Stone by disqualification, is chosen by Troy Tornado for the six-man match and wins it, makes a deal with Tommy Cornell over Tyson Baine, loses with John Anderson to Baine and Wolf Hawkins and at Psycho Circus beats Baine with a nightstick and the Long Arm of the Law.

name: Edd Stone
caption: A flying, unpredictable member of a wrestling family who fights as 'Edd-Fu', joins the Syndicate and takes the All Action Championship from Sammy Bach at Total Mayhem 13 with a top-rope Party's Over, and keeps it against Hell Monkey at Summer Showdown in July 2008, then against Art Reed at Hotter Than Hell in August 2008, when Reed wins only by count out, and in September 2008 keeps it against the Cannonball Kid and Art Reed, beats Hell Monkey in a non-title match and teams with his brother Jeremy to beat the Keith Brothers, and in October 2008 beats Danny Fonzarelli with the Enforcers' help, is eliminated from the Hangtime match and, at Crunch Time, loses the title to Frankie Perez. In November 2008 he is beaten by Greg Keith's NeutronPlex on Badge of Honor, helps Tommy Cornell and his brother beat Sam Keith & the Machines, teams with Jeremy Stone to beat the Easy Riders, Tooth & Claw and the Conquering Kings and is eliminated with his brother in the three-team tag title match at A Little South Of Sanity. In December 2008 he loses with Sammy Bach to the Keith Family, caught in Sam Keith's Proton Lock, beats Hell Monkey & Teddy Powell and Team VIPER and, at Psycho Circus, wins the tag belts.

name: Teddy Powell
caption: A former DaVE high flyer and Sammy Bach's old tag team partner, who shows up in a hoodie on Total Wrestling in August 2008 to hit Bach with the Motion Censor, forms the Disrespected with Stevie Grayson and beats the Fly Boys on Badge of Honor, before a savage brawl in which Bach chokes him out with a tag rope, and in September 2008 runs in on Sammy Bach on three Total Wrestling shows running, loses to the Easy Riders and is disqualified for beating Bach with a chair at Destructive Energy. In November 2008 he beats Shingen Miyazaki with the Motion Censor, loses to Remo Richardson's Lumbar Puncture and says he intends to move into the All Action division. In December 2008 he is beaten in the six-man match won by Aaron Andrews and loses with Hell Monkey to the Easy Riders.

name: Stevie Grayson
caption: Wolf Hawkins' former tag team partner, who says Hawkins ended their team two and a half years before the diary's August 2008 and TCW released him half a year later, and who is revealed as Teddy Powell's ally, takes his revenge on Hawkins with a low blow and a DDT onto a chair and loses to Brent Hill in four minutes on Badge of Honor, and in September 2008 hits Wolf Hawkins with a chair, draws with the British Lions by no contest, loses to the Easy Riders and loses with Teddy Powell at Destructive Energy. In November 2008 he is beaten by Tyson Baine with three Hades Bombs after Wolf Hawkins feeds him to Baine.

name: Steve Flash
caption: One of TCW's three trainers, who between them, the diary says, have won championships in America, Mexico and Japan, and whom Brent Hill remembers wrestling at Rapid Pro Wrestling when he was at his best; Rick Law sends him with Bairei Yasujiro and Pistol Pete Hall against Eric Tyler's side on Badge of Honor in August 2008.

name: Bairei Yasujiro
caption: A TCW trainer and high flyer, billed as the least over of the three trainers Rick Law names on Badge of Honor in August 2008, who submits to Eric Tyler's Tradition Lift after Laura Huggins pulls Steve Flash off the apron.

name: Pistol Pete Hall
caption: The third of TCW's trainers, with the Pistol Whip Lariat, who with Steve Flash and Bairei Yasujiro faces Eric Tyler, Freddy Huggins and Acid on Badge of Honor in August 2008.

name: Merle O'Curle
caption: The Irish half of the British Lions, a ruthless limb-worker who debuts with Walter Morgan on Badge of Honor in August 2008, dislikes the team's name, and loses to the New Wave and to Kingman & Alexander. In September 2008 he and Walter Morgan lose twice to the Rising Stars, draw with the Disrespected by no contest and lose to the Keith Brothers. In November 2008 he loses to Eddie Peak, takes part in the second All Action Championship contendership match and loses with Walter Morgan to the New Wave. In December 2008 he and Walter Morgan lose to the Conquering Kings and to Art Reed & Sean Deeley, and he is beaten by Johnny Bloodstone.

name: Walter Morgan
caption: The other British Lion, a submission specialist the commentary calls better on the mat than much of the roster, who is beaten with Merle O'Curle by the New Wave and by Kingman & Alexander in August 2008. In September 2008 he and Merle O'Curle lose twice to the Rising Stars, draw with the Disrespected by no contest, and he submits to Matt Keith's Proton Lock. In November 2008 he and Merle O'Curle lose to the New Wave on Badge of Honor. In December 2008 he loses with Merle O'Curle to RDJ & Fonzarelli, to Conquering Kings and to Art Reed & Sean Deeley.

name: JD Morgan
caption: A former three-time DaVE Extreme Champion who debuts in August 2008, sponsors the British Lions and UK Dragon, and loses to Ricky Dale Johnson and Art Reed. In September 2008 he loses to Rocky Golden and to Aaron Andrews. In November 2008 he loses to Sam Keith's Proton Lock in a wrestling exhibition, then to the New Wave with American Buffalo. In December 2008 he is beaten by Koshiro Ino's Kobra's Bite on Badge of Honor.

name: UK Dragon
caption: A masked Briton allied to JD Morgan who, as Acid's partner in the team called Acid Dragon, loses to the Disrespected on Badge of Honor in August 2008, then takes part in a four-way match with Aaron Andrews, Freddy Huggins and Shingen Miyazaki. In September 2008 he is one of four in a singles match won by Acid. In November 2008 he teams with Acid against Steve Gumble in a three-way match and takes Acid's Acid Rain Bomb when Gumble twists clear. In December 2008 he is beaten in the six-man match won by Aaron Andrews and loses to the New Wave with Acid.

name: Greg Keith
caption: One of Sam Keith's eighteen-year-old twin sons, who arrives on Total Wrestling in August 2008 beside his father and Johnny Bloodstone, and is pinned by Brent Hill in the Keith Brothers' first match, against the Machines on Badge of Honor. In September 2008 he takes the pin from Chris Rockwell's brass knuckles, drops a title match to the New Wave, suffers Tommy Cornell's Rough Ride and Guilt Trip and taps to Jeremy Stone's Stone Hold. In October 2008 he beats Elite Express with the Proton Lock and is caught in the Emergency Stop by the Easy Riders. In November 2008 he beats Edd Stone with the NeutronPlex, loses to Tommy Cornell's Guilt Trip, wins the first six-man contendership match, beats the Enforcers with his brother and at A Little South Of Sanity taps to the P-Clutch in the All Action Championship four-way. In December 2008 he is beaten by the Easy Riders with a big boot, helps beat Sammy Bach & the Easy Riders with his father and beats the Fly Boys with a Proton Lock on Donnie J.

name: Matt Keith
caption: The other of Sam Keith's twin sons, who comes into TCW with his brother in August 2008 after Tommy Cornell's lawyers contest their contracts, and is billed with Greg Keith as the Keith Brothers. In September 2008 he wins with the Proton Lock over Miyazaki & Ota and Walter Morgan, trades submission holds with Sean Deeley and fights Tommy Cornell and the Syndicate beside his brother and father. In October 2008 he loses to Jeremy Stone, beats the Disrespected and the School of Tradition with his brother and falls to the Easy Riders. In November 2008 he loses to Chris Rockwell, loses to Tommy Cornell & Wolf Hawkins, is eliminated in the first six-man contendership match, beats the Enforcers with his brother and debuts the Photon Breaker with Greg. In December 2008 he is beaten by the Easy Riders, helps beat Sammy Bach & the Easy Riders with his father and beats the Fly Boys with Greg.

name: Jeremy Stone
caption: Edd Stone's big brother, a son of Dan Stone billed the Canadian Wrestling Machine and heir to the holds of the House of Stone, who debuts on Badge of Honor in September 2008 as the Syndicate's newest member and beats Art Reed with the Stone Hold, then teams with Edd to beat the Keith Brothers and, at Destructive Energy, loses to Sam Keith's Proton Lock in a No Holds Barred match for the Hard Hitting Championship. In October 2008 he beats Matthew Keith, explains in Horatio Dangerous' interview why he left the family company, beats Johnny Bloodstone & Ricky Dale Johnson with Tommy Cornell and, at Crunch Time, is the third man in the World Heavyweight Championship match that Troy Tornado wins. In November 2008 he promises that both Stone brothers will hold gold by the end of the year, loses to Troy Tornado's Star Maker, beats the Conquering Kings, the Easy Riders and Tooth & Claw with Edd Stone and is eliminated with him at A Little South Of Sanity. In December 2008 he beats Ricky Dale Johnson, loses to Rick Law by disqualification when Tyson Baine attacks, attacks Troy Tornado after a tag loss, loses the six-man match with Remo Richardson and Chris Rockwell and at Psycho Circus loses the three-way match to Troy Tornado.

name: Jack Marlowe
caption: Half of the Enforcers, the Syndicate's replacement for the Machines, who with Julian Watson jumps John Anderson on Total Wrestling in September 2008, revives their old Philly Pro finish, the Gojira Falls, takes the pin when the Young Guns' Blitzkrieg Bop beats the Enforcers and Edd Stone in a six-man tag and loses to the New Wave on Badge of Honor. In October 2008 he helps Edd Stone beat Danny Fonzarelli and loses to John Anderson in an International Championship match. In November 2008 he loses to Aaron Andrews' Northern Lights suplex and to the Keith Brothers with the Enforcers. In December 2008 he and Julian Watson target the Keith twins from behind in the Badge of Honor beatdown.

name: Julian Watson
caption: The other Enforcer, who with Jack Marlowe attacks John Anderson in September 2008 and is left limping by the Gojira Falls, then submits to Scout's Special Force when the New Wave beat the Enforcers on Badge of Honor. In November 2008 he helps Jack Marlowe against Aaron Andrews, loses to the Keith Brothers with the Enforcers and develops a vendetta against referee Sam Sparrow. In December 2008 he and Jack Marlowe target the Keith twins from behind in the Badge of Honor beatdown.

name: Marat Khoklov
caption: A giant Russian whom Eric Tyler brings to Badge of Honor in September 2008, saying the School of Tradition has friends in Japan, though he holds no TCW contract: he flattens Rick Law there and, in an unsanctioned match at Destructive Energy, snaps Rocky Golden's baseball bat in two and beats him senseless. In November 2008 he walks out to the Psalm 69 theme to cut Eddie Peak down in his match with Eric Tyler, draws with Remo Richardson against Peak & Ricky Dale Johnson, beats Joey Minnesota with the Moscow Lariat and at A Little South Of Sanity wins a No Disqualification match against Peak.

name: Alanis Springsteen
caption: Kingman & Alexander's manager, a woman Jason Azaria cannot name on air until he remembers she debuted as Alanis Springsteen, who walks to ringside as the British Lions are beaten in August 2008 and in September 2008 renames her team the Conquering Kings, telling them to draw courage from their namesakes. In November 2008 she walks to ringside with the Conquering Kings and panics as American Buffalo grabs her. In December 2008 she is at ringside for the Conquering Kings against the British Lions and Elite Express.

name: Remo Richardson
caption: A huge brawler, Phil Vibert's 'supreme specimen' in October 2008, whom Sam Keith, head booker at the rival promotion when he was recruited, has backed for six years, and who wins the ten-man battle royal on Total Wrestling with five eliminations to take the third place in the World Heavyweight Championship match, beats Danny Fonzarelli with the Destroyer and, at Crunch Time, is the third man in the three-way match that Troy Tornado wins. In November 2008 he beats Rick Law with the Destroyer on the third try, draws with Marat Khoklov against Eddie Peak & Ricky Dale Johnson, injures Johnson with a chair, beats Aaron Andrews, Teddy Powell and, with Sammy Bach, Rick Law & Sam Keith and at A Little South Of Sanity beats Johnson when Phil Vibert holds his boot. In December 2008 he beats Sean Deeley with the Destroyer, wins with Frankie Perez over Tooth & Claw and the Balcony Express, loses the six-man match, helps beat down Ricky Dale Johnson and at Psycho Circus loses to Johnson in a steel cage match.

name: Phil Vibert
caption: A manager and booker familiar to wrestling fans, who walks into Total Wrestling in October 2008 saying he has come to take as much money out of the company as he can, demands a place in the Crunch Time main event for his client and takes notes on a spiral-bound pad as Remo Richardson wins his way into the World Heavyweight Championship match. In November 2008 he tells Aaron Andrews he will not manage him, taunts Floyd Goldworthy, says on Total Wrestling that he means to manage all the big winners and at A Little South Of Sanity defines TCW for Ricky Dale Johnson and cheats for Remo Richardson. In December 2008 he tells Ricky Dale Johnson that Remo Richardson turned down the shot at the world title, takes Frankie Perez into the camp and mocks Chris Rockwell at Psycho Circus.

name: Carl Batch
caption: The manager who walks down to ringside on Badge of Honor in October 2008, another face familiar to fans of DaVE, to take over the Easy Riders from Karen Killer, saying he took the Peak boys under his wing, and who steers them through the tag tournament to a title match with the New Wave at Crunch Time. In December 2008 he manages the Easy Riders, demands a no-disqualification tag title match and at Psycho Circus holds the chain that chokes Scout as the Easy Riders win the belts.

name: Bobby Thomas
caption: Half of the Elite Express, a Canadian team new to TCW in October 2008 that loses to the Keith Brothers on Total Wrestling, when Bobby is made to submit to the Proton Lock, and to the Machines on Badge of Honor. In December 2008 he wins with the Elite Express over the Young Guns and Tooth & Claw and loses to the Conquering Kings.

name: Nate Johnson
caption: The other half of the Elite Express, a Canadian tag team with a championship pedigree elsewhere, who loses to the Keith Brothers on Total Wrestling in October 2008 and to the Machines on Badge of Honor, the Ammo Dump and the King of the Hill finishing him. In December 2008 he wins with the Elite Express over the Young Guns and Tooth & Claw and loses to the Conquering Kings, pinned after the Crippler Bomb.

name: Texas Pete
caption: A big Texan who returns to TCW in November 2008 after about nine months away, a different man from the one who vanished as 2007 closed: patient, fitter, faster and picking his moments. He beats Joey Minnesota with a revamped Lone Star Drop, takes John Anderson to a fifteen-minute International Championship match that Wolf Hawkins decides, loses to the Machines in a tag match with Hawkins as his unwilling partner and to Rick Law, and at A Little South Of Sanity, in what the diary says would be the first title of his six-year career, loses the three-way International Championship match when Anderson pins Hawkins. In December 2008 he tells his story to Horatio Dangerous, loses to RDJ & Fonzarelli with Frankie Perez, is disqualified against Sam Keith when Sammy Bach chairs Keith and at Psycho Circus chairs Bach.

name: Lobo Blanco
caption: A Mexican technician new to TCW in November 2008, who makes his debut on Badge of Honor as one of Tommy Cornell's tests, loses to Cornell's Rough Ride and then, as half of Tooth & Claw with the American Eagle, loses to the Easy Riders and to the Stone Brothers and is one of six in the second All Action Championship contendership match, won by Art Reed. In December 2008 he loses with the American Eagle to the Elite Express and to Frankie Perez & Remo Richardson.

name: American Eagle
caption: A masked wrestler created in November 2008 for Dave Wallace, who had worked in TCW's developmental territory under the ring name Air Attack Weasel: a tennis player turned wrestler whom the narrator, on the advice of his son Adrian, calls a jobber for life, unrivalled at selling and willing to take any stunt, and whose mask the company keeps as it keeps MAW's Kid Arachnid. He debuts on Badge of Honor as half of Tooth & Claw with Lobo Blanco, loses to the Easy Riders and, on Total Wrestling, to the Stone Brothers and, alone, to Tyson Baine's Hades Bomb, and takes a Precision Driller in the six-man contendership match won by Greg Keith. In December 2008 he loses with Lobo Blanco to the Elite Express and to Frankie Perez & Remo Richardson, after countering a powerbomb into a pinfall that Remo powers out of before two.

name: Dean Waldorf
caption: Half of the Balcony Express, a young team managed by Randall Hopkirk and billed as a work in progress, who debut on Badge of Honor in November 2008, are steamrollered by Tommy Cornell & Wolf Hawkins, with Cornell's Rough Ride finishing Waldorf, and lose to the School of Tradition when Joel Bryant pins him as Freddy Huggins' kick lands on Sean Deeley. In December 2008 he loses with Statler to Frankie Perez & Remo Richardson, taking Remo's Destroyer.

name: Statler
caption: The other half of the Balcony Express, Randall Hopkirk's young team that debuts on Badge of Honor in November 2008. He and Dean Waldorf lose to Tommy Cornell & Wolf Hawkins; against the School of Tradition he comes in to break up the One Shot Drop on Waldorf and is cut off by Sean Deeley's German suplex. In December 2008 he loses with Dean Waldorf to Frankie Perez & Remo Richardson, taking a side kick from the top rope and the pin.

name: Hidekazu
caption: A newcomer in the same facepaint Shingen Miyazaki wears, who arrives in the no contest on Badge of Honor in November 2008 between Acid, Eric Tyler & Freddy Huggins and Koshiro Ino & Team VIPER, arriving with a DDT to Acid and an armlock takedown on Sean Deeley. In December 2008 he loses on his debut to Eric Tyler's Tradition Lift after a thumb to the eye.

name: Kate Dangerous
caption: Horatio Dangerous's daughter, a ten-year veteran who has competed worldwide and, earlier in 2008, held a championship in a Japanese women's promotion the diary calls a strong claim to the best in the world; she signs with TCW in December 2008 and moves back to America. She makes her TCW debut on Badge of Honor in the first intergender tag in TCW history, with her father against Chris Rockwell and Lauren Easter, challenges Rockwell for a rematch at Psycho Circus, asks Aaron Andrews to partner her only for Tommy Cornell to claim him, and teams there with Rocky Golden, losing to Rockwell and Easter when Golden taps to the Furusawa Armbar and Easter's Northern Lights suplex stops her breaking it up. Mayhem Midden announces at Psycho Circus that TCW will introduce a Women's Championship in 2009, to be first awarded at Malice in Wonderland, and wishes her and Lauren Easter luck.

name: Lauren Easter
caption: A newcomer to TCW and to the business, brought in by Chris Rockwell as the wrestler he turns to after Frankie Perez abandons him, who works in the Angel Athletic Association and whom the diary presents as Rockwell's protege and manager. She dropkicks Frankie Perez on Badge of Honor, wins the first intergender tag in TCW history with Rockwell over Horatio and Kate Dangerous and, at Psycho Circus, wins the second, catching Kate Dangerous with a Northern Lights suplex while Rockwell makes Rocky Golden tap out. Mayhem Midden wishes her luck for Malice in Wonderland, where the new Women's Championship will first be awarded.

name: Sayeed Ali
caption: A noted Canadian competitor who makes his TCW debut on Total Wrestling in December 2008 against Brent Hill, brawling out of holds for much of the match before Hill sinks him with the Ammo Dump and forces the submission with the Complete Package.

name: Rhino Umaga
caption: A Samoan warrior who has cut a feared swathe across Japan and arrives in TCW on Badge of Honor in December 2008. He does well on his debut against Eddie Peak and takes two Peaks of Perfection to be put down, then is outmatched in a second match by Rocky Golden, who hides the Rocky Road low blow from the referee.

name: Jack Bruce
caption: Painful Procedure's first lead vocalist, whose song has not been heard in TCW since 2004. He returns on the last Total Wrestling of 2008 as Troy Tornado is about to win his match with Tommy Cornell, does not look happy about it, squares up to Tornado, side-kicks Tommy Cornell alongside him and is dropped by a tornado backfist when he aims a kick at Tornado, and on Badge of Honor argues with Randall Hopkirk, whom he tells that the two of them are the only ones left of the band and that the new kid does not care about music.
